goal: Phase 1 (coordinator-and-resume) of campaign harden-chain-and-verification: a promotion that moves nothing records nothing, resume honours the base ref a chain-launched run was cut from, and status keeps moving while the controller awaits verification. definitionOfDone.text: campaign, chain and chain-restart tests pass
a second promotion of the same run through promoteRunInCampaign appends nothing, and the code path is the status guard, not a sha comparison

taskPacket.objective: A run the land branch already carries is not re-recorded: promoteRun's already_promoted result appends no promotion record, so a coordinator restart leaves campaign.json's promotions unchanged.
instructions: Evidence (measured 2026-09-16, campaign register-skill-and-harden): campaign.json holds four promotion records for contract 1 -- 94cc1da->94cc1da, c8fa436->c8fa436, and after a coordinator restart 9d42573->9d42573 -- for one real promotion. Cause: src/repo/integrate.mjs promoteRun returns {status: 'already_promoted', sha: current, previousSha: current} when the run head is already an ancestor of the land branch and still calls onPromoted; src/campaign/index.mjs promoteRunInCampaign's onPromoted passes it to recordPromotion, whose dedupe is by (runId, sha), and the land head has moved since the run's real record.

Fix at the seam: in src/campaign/index.mjs promoteRunInCampaign, introduce `promotionMovedBranch(record)` (true only when record.status === 'promoted') and record only when it is true; an already_promoted result returns as before but writes nothing. Keep promoteRun's return shape and recordPromotion's existing (runId, sha) dedupe.

Tests: add a test to test/campaign/campaign.test.mjs next to 'recording a promotion is idempotent by run and sha' that promotes a run twice through promoteRunInCampaign against a real temp repo (the file already builds one for the other promotion tests) and asserts promotions.length stays 1 with the second result status 'already_promoted'. test/campaign/chain.test.mjs is at 798 lines: do not add to it; if you want the coordinator-restart shape, put it in a new file test/campaign/chain-restart.test.mjs built from chain.test.mjs's existing helpers by import or by copying only what you need.
Document the behaviour in one sentence in docs/CONCEPTS.md where promotions are described (search for 'promotion' or 'land branch').
decisions: The seam is promoteRunInCampaign, not promoteRun: promoteRun's already_promoted return is used by callers that want the current head.
recordPromotion keeps its (runId, sha) dedupe; the new guard is about status, not sha.
nonGoals: No change to how the chain classifies runs or decides to launch.

taskPacket.objective: A run launched with --base-ref records that ref in its source identity, and resume captures the current identity against the same ref, so a chain-launched run resumes from any checkout without 'source drift detected in gitHead'.
instructions: Evidence (measured 2026-09-16): `faberun resume --detach .runs/register-skill-and-harden-2-engine-determinism --node unpriced-usage-visible` was refused with 'source drift detected in gitHead' while HEAD was main; the run had been launched by the chain with `--base-ref campaign/register-skill-and-harden` (gitHead 9d42573). Detaching HEAD at 9d42573 made resume work. Cause: src/engine/run-identity.mjs captureRunIdentity takes the base from the module-level pendingLaunchBaseRef that only `run --base-ref` sets (src/cli.mjs setLaunchBaseRef); src/engine/resume.mjs:117 calls captureRunIdentity(contract, scopeBoundaries) with no base, so it measures HEAD.

Change: captureSourceIdentity/captureRunIdentity record the base ref they were given as `baseRef` (string|null) on the SourceIdentity they return (typedef in run-identity.mjs). In src/engine/resume.mjs, before recapturing, read storedMetadata.sourceIdentity.baseRef and pass it to captureRunIdentity as its third argument; introduce `recordedBaseRef(metadata)` in run-identity.mjs for that lookup (null when absent, so runs recorded before this change keep today's HEAD comparison). assertSourceUnchanged must not treat the new field as drift: add 'baseRef' to nothing, or skip it explicitly -- the compared fields list stays cwd, gitHead, dirtyTreeFingerprint, packetHashes, harnessVersions.

run.json: src/engine/state.mjs createRunMetadata already stores sourceIdentity whole, so the field lands there without a new writer; confirm and do not add a second writer. docs/FIELD-OWNERSHIP.md governs events.jsonl and journal.jsonl only; run.json is out of its scope, so it needs no change -- verify by running test/campaign/field-ownership.test.mjs.

Tests: extend test/repo/base-ref.test.mjs (its first test launches with --base-ref against a real temp repo) to assert run.json's sourceIdentity.baseRef equals the ref, and add a test in a new file test/engine/resume-base-ref.test.mjs that launches with --base-ref, moves the checkout HEAD to an unrelated commit, and shows resume proceeds (use the fixtures test/engine/resume.test.mjs uses; that file is 649 lines, do not grow it past 800).

Docs: one sentence under `## faberun resume` in docs/COMMANDS.md saying a run launched with --base-ref resumes against that ref from any checkout. Do not touch skills/faberun/references/operations.md (at its byte ceiling).
decisions: No new CLI flag: the recorded ref is the source of truth, and docs/COMMANDS.md's command-surface test stays untouched.
Runs recorded before this change have no baseRef and keep comparing HEAD.

taskPacket.objective: While the controller awaits a verification child, status.json keeps moving: the node record says 'verification k/n' with the running argv, and driveRun renders on a timer instead of only between ticks.
instructions: Evidence (measured 2026-09-16): during unpriced-usage-visible attempt 4, `faberun status` showed `running (worker)` with lastTick 16:45 while verification-1..9.json were being written until 17:01; the drive loop awaits executeControllerVerification (src/engine/lifecycle.mjs:567) inside the tick, and renderStatusIfChanged (src/engine/scheduler.mjs:296) runs only between ticks.

Change 1, scheduler: in driveRun start `setInterval(() => renderStatusIfChanged(), pollMs)` (unref it) for the life of the loop and clear it in the finally; the render is already change-detecting, so an idle timer writes nothing.

Change 2, verify: in src/engine/verify.mjs executeControllerVerification and verifyCandidateWorkspace pass onAttemptStart/onAttemptComplete callbacks to runVerification (src/engine/run-command.mjs already accepts them for the ledger; keep the existing ledger use) that write the node snapshot with `phase: 'verification'` and a bounded `verificationProgress: {index, total, argv}` object; introduce `verificationProgress(index, total, argv)` in verify.mjs to build it (argv joined and bounded to 120 bytes). Clear the field when verification ends.

Change 3, render: src/report/render.mjs nowLine and the per-node payload show `verification k/n · <argv>` when a running node carries verificationProgress; the row's phase column shows 'verification'. Keep status.json under its advisory ceiling (the payload test in test/web/server.test.mjs asserts under 200 KB).

Tests: a unit test for verificationProgress and the render line in a new test/report/now-line.test.mjs (test/report has cost.test.mjs and next.test.mjs; mirror their fixture style), and an engine test in a new test/engine/verification-progress.test.mjs that runs executeControllerVerification against a two-command verification (use process.execPath -e fixtures) and asserts the node JSON carried phase 'verification' with index 1 of 2 at the first onAttemptStart (capture through a writeNode spy or by reading the file inside a fixture command). Do not assert elapsed time from above.
Node JSON fields are not in docs/FIELD-OWNERSHIP.md's scope (events.jsonl and journal.jsonl only); events.jsonl must not gain a new writer here.
decisions: A timer in driveRun, not a callback threaded through lifecycle: the render is change-detecting and the event loop is free while a child runs.
Progress lives on the node snapshot, not in events.jsonl.
